# Membrane Matroska plugin v0.6.3 - Table of Contents

> Matroska Plugin for Membrane Multimedia Framework

## Pages

- [Membrane Matroska Plugin](https://membrane-matroska-plugin.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [Membrane.Matroska.Demuxer](https://membrane-matroska-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Matroska.Demuxer.md): Filter element for demuxing Matroska files.
- [Membrane.Matroska.Muxer](https://membrane-matroska-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Matroska.Muxer.md): Filter element for muxing Matroska files.
- [Membrane.Matroska.Parser.EBML](https://membrane-matroska-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Matroska.Parser.EBML.md): Helper functions for decoding and encoding EBML elements.
- [Membrane.Matroska.Schema](https://membrane-matroska-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Matroska.Schema.md): Matroska structure schema for muxing and demuxing
